baseRules: Maintain the original composition and camera framing unless the requested edit changes them.
Keep the image content outside the painted mask unchanged.
Match the surrounding lighting, shadows, color temperature, sharpness, and texture.
Create natural transitions without a visible seam, halo, bright fringe, or patched edge.

intents.label: Sửa chi tiết nhỏ
qualityRules: Change only the selected small detail and retain its original scale and placement.
intents.negativePrompt: different face, changed composition, extra objects, distorted details

intents.label: Chỉnh trang phục
qualityRules: Keep fabric construction, folds, seams, and the natural boundary between fabric and skin coherent.
intents.negativePrompt: different face, altered body proportions, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted garment

intents.label: Xóa đối tượng
qualityRules: Reconstruct the masked area from surrounding scene geometry, texture, and lighting.
intents.negativePrompt: new object, duplicated object, changed subject, seam, halo

intents.label: Thay nền
qualityRules: Keep the main subject unchanged and make the new environment perspective and lighting coherent.
intents.negativePrompt: changed face, changed outfit, changed pose, duplicate subject

intents.label: Thêm đối tượng vào cảnh
qualityRules: Place the new subject or object with consistent scale, perspective, contact shadows, and scene lighting.
intents.negativePrompt: duplicate main subject, wrong perspective, floating object, malformed anatomy

intents.label: Sửa tư thế hoặc biểu cảm
qualityRules: Use a clear final pose state with anatomically coherent joints, fingers, fabric tension, and contact points.
intents.negativePrompt: different face, bad hands, fused fingers, extra digits, extra limbs, distorted anatomy

intents.label: Hòa nhân vật vào nền
qualityRules: Blend the subject silhouette into the environment. Match ambient exposure, color cast, contact shadows, depth, and edge texture.
intents.negativePrompt: changed face, changed outfit, changed pose, halo, bright fringe, floating appearance

intents.label: Khớp ánh sáng và màu
qualityRules: Adjust only exposure, color temperature, and local contrast. Preserve all geometry and material detail.
intents.negativePrompt: changed geometry, changed face, changed pose, plastic skin, blurred texture

intents.label: Sửa viền hoặc texture
qualityRules: Repair only the narrow transition band or selected texture area. Preserve material separation between skin, hair, fabric, and background.
intents.negativePrompt: halo, bright fringe, hard edge, plastic skin, blurred fabric, changed content

intents.label: Thêm bóng tiếp xúc
qualityRules: Create a soft contact shadow consistent with the scene key light and ground texture.
intents.negativePrompt: floating subject, hard black shadow, changed subject, changed ground geometry

intents.label: Hoàn thiện ảnh
qualityRules: Preserve all content. Improve only consistency of fine texture, film grain, sharpness, and color grading.
intents.negativePrompt: different face, changed pose, changed outfit, oversharpen, artifacts, loss of detail
